core_job:
For people who buy most of their clothes and shoes online: log each order with the size you ordered, mark it Kept or Returned (too small, too big, too long, too short, didn't like it, faulty), and never miss its return-by date. All data is entered by the user and stays on the device. There is no price feed and no network call for the core job.

Why the app needs a new job: today every release build is an empty shell. With no AGL_API_GATEWAY defines, every catalog fetch throws PriceFeedNotConnected (lib/main.dart:78-89, env/prod.json). Every tab shows 'Prices are unavailable'. Add-a-product is hidden (onAdd is null) and Saved cannot be reached. Only Profile works.

Baseline today: flutter analyze is clean and all 908 tests pass.
signature:
"My size at this brand". Type a brand (optionally a category) and the app answers from your own history only, showing the evidence: the most recent kept size, bounded by any too-small or too-big returns, with conflicts shown as "Mixed results". It never uses brand size charts and never converts sizes it has no record of.

Return-window reminders come with it: local notifications 3 days before and on the last day, a just-in-time permission request, and an honest state when permission is denied.

Competitors were checked only against their App Store listing text, via Apple's keyless iTunes Search API today:
- Clothi stores sizes by brand, but its listing does not mention whether you kept or returned an item, or return deadlines.
- Seel handles returns through Gmail sync and AI, but does not learn your size per brand.
- Stylebook, Indyx and Acloset are wardrobe and cost-per-wear apps.

Web search was unavailable, so any other competitor is not verified. No sibling app in the portfolio has this job (grep across /Users/spatchava/agl).
must: M1 Core job end to end on a fresh install with no network: Add order (brand, category, size parser for letter / numeric / waist x length / shoe size with system / one size / free text, store, optional link and price, return-by quick picks), then Kept / Returned with reason / Exchanged / Edit / Delete with undo. Paste link names the store from the host via lib/domain/stores.dart and never fetches the page. Delete every screen, domain and data file that cannot work (browse, deals, results, product, compare, add_product, saved, catalog_states, catalog, compare, offers, price_track, price_history, filters, disclosure, alerts, tracking, product_repository, remote, unconnected, product_dto, gateway config). lib/ reads no AGL_API_GATEWAY_* or AGL_AFFILIATE_TAGS define.

M2 Signature: lib/domain/size_answer.dart, pure Dart. Brand names are normalised, the answer is the most recent kept size, returns bound it, conflicts show as 'Mixed results', fallbacks are labelled other category / other brand, and the empty state is honest. Home has a 'Find my size' field and each brand has a page. Return reminders use flutter_local_notifications with timezone: 2 per order, cancelled when the order is resolved or deleted, rescheduled when the date is edited. Permission is asked just in time, and a 'Reminders are off' state links to system settings.

M3 Depth: versioned on-device persistence (orders.v1) with a migration that clears the v2.2 keys. One search across brand, store, size and notes. Filter chips Out for trial / Kept / Returned plus category, and three sort orders. Share my sizes as text and export all orders as CSV, both through the share sheet. Totals use only the user's own data. Explicit states for first run, brand with no history, no search results, overdue order, notifications denied and storage write failure.

M4 Own identity: 'fitting room' palette. Light: stone #F3F4F1, ink #1B1A1F, garnet #7A1F3D, tape yellow #E8B931 (chip fill only), kept sage #5E7D6A, returned clay #C2603F, hairline #E9EAE6. Dark: #141216, #1F1C22, #F1EEF2, #D46A8C, #8FB59D, #E38B6C. Remove the Amazon hexes 131A22, 232F3E, FF9900, B12704, 0F1111. Bundle Bodoni Moda (titles and the size answer) and Jost (UI), both OFL from google/fonts, and remove the unbundled 'Roboto'. Label-tag size chips, 2px cards, measuring-tape countdown bars. Home is one large-title scroll view (Find my size / Out for trial / Brands / Insights) with no bottom tab bar, using Cupertino widgets on iOS. AglAdBanner moves inline, the tab-switch interstitial is removed, and onboarding and Settings get app-specific copy. Delete lib/app_env.dart (unused, byte-identical to 4 other apps).

M5 Template tells removed: a grep of lib/ finds none of 'Prices are unavailable', 'Live prices not connected', 'not connected', 'in this build', 'coming soon', 'Where prices come from', 'Nothing saved yet', 'BEST VALUE', 'Biggest discounts', 'Shop by category', 'Get started', the gateway or affiliate define names, Roboto, or the Amazon hexes. New vector icon: garnet label tag with yellow stitching on stone, no hanger, no Material glyph, no gradient, regenerated for iOS and Android. LaunchScreen uses the new palette. Fix the pubspec description, and update or delete the stale agl.config.json that describes the old 'StyleRadar' React Native app.

M6 Honest / 5.6: user-entered data only, with no sample orders or seeded brands. Delete test/support/sample_catalog.dart. No build-time switch changes what the user sees; SCREENSHOT may only suppress ads, pending founder question 5. Privacy choices row always visible, replacing the region-conditional _PrivacyChoices. No demo login, remote config, region / date / reviewer detection or hidden gestures, and every feature is within 2 taps of Home. M7 Proven: flutter analyze clean and all tests pass. Tests for removed features are deleted only with the feature, each listed in the commit message, and infrastructure tests are adapted without weakening them. New tests: size_parse, size_answer (including a property that the answer never contains a size absent from the history), return_window, link_store with a no-HTTP assertion, order_store, reminders with a fake scheduler, widget journeys, identity_test. Rewrite integration_test/store_screenshots_test.dart so it needs no gateway. Commit path-limited, never fastlane/ or ios/Podfile.lock, and push to main. Build for the simulator and screenshot the new screens.

M8 Store impact (spec section 5): new name or subtitle, description, keywords, SHOPPING primary category, 5 screenshots to retake from real QA orders, bespoke review notes with real test steps and real devices, privacy label unchanged. Applied by store-compliance, not by the office submitting anything.
must_fix: Release is blocked on founder question 6 (Charter §6): the founder must approve the drafted privacy policy (agl-manifest/ai-office/reports/approvals/2026-10-12-fashionfactory-privacy-policy.md), and it must be applied to docs/privacy-policy.html, before criterion 6 can pass. This is a founder decision, not a developer fix.

The developer's claim that 'once the founder approves the drafted policy and it is applied, all tests should pass and the 2 commits can be pushed as they are' is wrong. (a) test/security/privacy_policy_test.dart:327-337 hard-codes `expect(requested, <String>{'INTERNET'})`, so it keeps failing while AndroidManifest requests RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED, whatever the policy says. The expected set has to change together with the approved policy. (b) privacy_policy_test.dart:407 still asserts `read(policy) contains 'api.fashionfactory.americangroupllc.com'`. The only occurrence of that host is docs/privacy-policy.html:250, in the 'Network activity' section, which the draft replaces with text that does not contain it. Applying the draft as written will therefore add a 4th failure. That assertion should be flipped to assert the host is absent, in the same commit as the policy change.

After the policy is applied and the coupled test changes are made: re-run the full `flutter test` until it shows 0 failures, then push 0fcbad3, f087bd7 and the follow-up to origin/main. Do not stage fastlane/ or ios/Podfile.lock, which still hold someone else's uncommitted edits.
